tasks_completed.description: Extended pretool-quality-gate.py with sentinel-file bypass path in parallel to W1's env-var path
tasks_completed.changes: Added _bypass_reason(file_path) helper that checks env-var first (preserves W1), then globs .claude/dev-registry/dev-*/bypass-quality-gate.flag (requires sibling dev.json). _bypass_quality_gate() rewritten to delegate to _bypass_reason and print the returned audit string. Stderr audit lines distinguish the two paths verbatim (BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE=1 vs sentinel <path>).
tasks_completed.rationale: Round-2 OBJ-4 mitigation: env-var path is unreachable when the orchestrator cannot inject env into the subagent's Bash subprocess. Sentinel-file path is filesystem-mediated and survives subprocess boundaries. Both paths supported in parallel.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: W1 dev-report-20260513-090000-W1.json wired BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE=1 env-var; Phase-B revealed env propagation across harness-spawned hook subprocess is unreliable
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: W1 chose env-var as sole binding contract; orchestrator cannot reliably propagate environment into per-tool-call hook subprocess invocations
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Sentinel file under .claude/dev-registry/dev-*/bypass-quality-gate.flag is filesystem-mediated and observable by any process with cwd=project root, eliminating the env-propagation dependency while preserving the W1 env-var path as a still-supported alternative.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Quality-gate hook applies a delta-check on its own functions (worsened-from-N-to-M test). The naive in-place extension grew _bypass_quality_gate from 11 to 19 lines and self-rejected. Extracting _bypass_reason as a separate small helper keeps _bypass_quality_gate at 9 lines (well under its original 11) and is the minimum diff that clears the hook's own quality bar. 23 lines total is only marginally above the 20-line guideline and is fully justified by the dogfood constraint.

dev.qa_notes: Verify by running the 4-test battery (TEST E/F/G/H below). Sentinel file path pattern is .claude/dev-registry/dev-*/bypass-quality-gate.flag (must have sibling dev.json). All 4 tests pass against this implementation.

blast_radius.note: Hook is invoked by Claude harness per tool call (PreToolUse Write|Edit matcher), not imported by other Python. No code-level callers exist.

implementation_notes: Sentinel sibling-check (dev.json existence) protects against stray .flag files in non-dev-registry directories or stale dev sessions where the dev.json was already cleaned but the flag remained.
Env-var path is checked BEFORE sentinel path (early return). In TEST H (both set), the env-var audit line is emitted; the sentinel is not evaluated. Acceptance criterion permits either path.
Bypass audit lines use the existing 'QUALITY GATE BYPASSED' prefix for grep-friendly log filtering.

Sentinel glob uses relative path .claude/dev-registry/...; hook must run with cwd=project root. This matches the existing pattern used elsewhere in the harness (PreToolUse hooks run with cwd inherited from the user's Claude session).

self_verification.smoke_check: pass (all 4 acceptance tests E/F/G/H verified — see verification.tests below)
self_verification.notes: Existing W1 env-var behavior verified preserved (TEST G + TEST H emit env-var audit line).

tests.actual: exit=2, 'QUALITY GATE BLOCKED — /tmp/qg-test-violator.py:\n  - File has 901 lines (max 800). Split into modules.'

tests.description: No env-var, sentinel present → allow + sentinel-triggered audit line
Env-var set, sentinel absent → allow + env-var audit line (W1 behavior preserved)
Env-var set AND sentinel present → allow + exactly one audit line (either path acceptable per AC)
tests.expected: exit=0, exactly one 'QUALITY GATE BYPASSED' line
tests.actual: exit=0, 'QUALITY GATE BYPASSED via BYPASS_QUALITY_GATE=1 — /tmp/qg-test-violator.py' (env-var checked first, sentinel not evaluated)

sentinel_path_pattern_notes: Glob is evaluated by hook with cwd=project root (i.e., /root/travel-planner). Hook additionally requires sibling .claude/dev-registry/dev-*/dev.json to exist (prevents stray flag files from triggering bypass on stale sessions). Orchestrator creates sentinel with: touch .claude/dev-registry/<active-dev-session-id>/bypass-quality-gate.flag where <active-dev-session-id> is the dev session directory (e.g., dev-20260513-090000) used for the current /dev cycle. Sentinel SHOULD be removed by orchestrator after dev cycle completes to keep audit-line state truthful for subsequent cycles.
recommendations: Orchestrator should add sentinel-create + sentinel-cleanup steps to the /dev cycle wrapper: 'touch .claude/dev-registry/<sid>/bypass-quality-gate.flag' before dispatching a worker that needs to edit a file already over the quality threshold, and 'rm -f' after the worker reports.

Consider documenting the sentinel mechanism in .claude/hooks/INDEX.md and in the quality-gate hook docstring at module level (not done by this worker to keep diff minimal; can be a follow-up doc-only commit).

If future workers add additional bypass mechanisms (e.g., per-file allowlist), extend _bypass_reason() rather than adding new branches in _bypass_quality_gate() — keeps the gate function under the delta-check threshold.
